messages.text: My miner is not working anymore

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist, Sarah passed this over to me.

Sorry to hear it stopped working. You have two different machines on your account, so let's start there: which one is it, the Bitaxe Gamma 602 or the NerdQaxe++?

And one quick detail: when you plug it in, what does the screen show? Blank, backlight only, or something with text or an error?
Need  qaxe ++

Got it, the NerdQaxe++ from Shop····.

Two things to start:

1. Plug it in and tell me what the screen does: completely blank, backlight on but no text, a logo then nothing, or text with an error?
2. Are the fans spinning when it is powered?

Also, if you know it, which Harlo OS / AxeOS version is on it (it shows in the web UI, or on the screen at boot).
Screen is black and fans bump spins
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill

Thanks, that is a useful symptom. Fans twitching and no screen almost always means the board is browning out the instant it tries to start, and on the NerdQaxe++ that points at the power supply before the board itself.

One check first:

1. Unplug it, wait 30 seconds, plug it back in on a different wall outlet, using a different cable if you have one. Same bump and stop?
2. Tell me which brick you are powering it with (the label rating, for example 5V 5A or 12V 5A), and whether it is the one that came in the box.

If you have any other supply with the same connector and at least the same rating, try that too, that one test usually settles it.
12 volt meanwell psu, the fuse on board blew . I put the same rated fuse in its place. New fuse did not blow but the miner is not working

That changes the picture. A fuse on the board only blows when something downstream shorted, so please do not fit a third fuse: if there is a short, you can turn a repairable board into a dead one, and worst case it gets hot.

Before I log this, two things from you, and please keep it unplugged while you take them:

1. A clear photo of the board around the fuse and the power input area, so I can see any scorching, a discoloured regulator or a lifted component.
2. A clear photo of the serial number label on the unit.

One question too: with the new fuse in, does anything at all happen when you power it, any fan twitch, any LED, or is it completely dead now?
Used rma verdict
Send those two photos when you can and tell me what it does on power now, and I will take it from there.
A led flashes about every second on the face of the board under the screen
Good detail. A once-a-second blink is usually either a status LED or a board resetting in a loop, and I do not want to guess which on your exact board. Let me check it against the NerdQaxe++ docs.
Searched the web · NerdQaxe++ LED blinking every second board no display
Searched the web · NerdQaxe++ status LED blink pattern ESP32 bootloop
Used rma verdict
I've recorded my findings and handed the chat back.

That is awesome, I really appreciate you guys taking care of that even
though it was just past the warranty. I'll get that boxed up and dropped
off at UPS. Thanks again for the help! Can't wait to get the 6th back in
the fleet!
